notes: The leading division is the one with the largest share of nominal revenue (line 2110) at the cell among firms with a statement and a positive revenue value; shares are within the year.

equivalence: OKVED 2 (OK 029-2014, Rosstat order of 31 January 2014) is built on NACE Rev. 2 with identical codes through four digits and national extensions at five and six digits; at the two-digit level the 88 division codes coincide (checked against the programming project's OKVED 2 crosswalk, motion.classifier-crosswalk, from Rosstat's OKVED2 download recorded in motion.classifier-sources); titles are translations and differ in emphasis (division 84's Russian title names military security and compulsory social insurance); known departures lie below the two-digit level and do not affect this layer. Codes outside OKVED 2 seen in the registry (__MISSING__, 00, 34, 40, 57) carry pseudo-division 0.
